title.english: The Great Detective Sherlock Holmes - The Greatest Jail-Breaker

media.description: In the late 19th century, Mack, a heroic outlaw who stole from the rich to give to the poor, was loved and respected by the people, but he had long been a difficult case for the Yard. With the help of Sherlock, detective Gordon Gorilla Riller and Carlson Fox finally managed to catch Mack at his daughter Katie's birthday party. But Sherlock was then reviled by the people for arresting their hero. Four years later, Mack fights with the notorious Scarface in prison, and then climbs over the wall to escape. While tracking down Mack, Sherlock discovers Mack's heart-breaking reason behind his escape, and decides to let him fulfill his final wish before he would voluntarily surrender to the police. However, Scarface suddenly appears and kidnaps Katie. Sherlock and Watson team up with Gordon Gorilla Riller and Carlson Fox for the rescue. A battle between life and death is unfolding.

Nanase lives in a village where the stars are the most beautiful in Japan and when she hears the story of Orihime and Hikoboshi, she gazes up at the night sky every day and thinks about them. When Nanase moved to a new town, she was shocked to see the sky of the city. There are no stars in the night sky, which means that Orihime and Hikoboshi cannot meet! Nanase unconsciously writes in her notebook, "How can I make the Milky Way?"

There were three girls who happened to find her scribbling in her notebook. Riko, the leader of the group and a strong person. Mio, who loves science. Airi is a sucker for anything trendy. This is the start of a reckless attempt to create the Milky Way by the four girls, who have very different interests and personalities.
